sonnet.problem: The true/false statement bundles two claims: that cries of distress ring out over the destruction on the way down to Horonaim, and that the cry is to flee. It should test one claim.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: This story card says the destroyer moves against every city and not one town will escape. That makes it plain that the valley and high plain are not spared, which gives away the answer to the true/false on card 11.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
